name: Creator LMS – The LMS for Creators, Coaches, and Trainers
author: WPFunnels

sections.description:
If you are a course creator or planning to go online with your courses anytime soon, then experience the newest LMS plugin for WordPress- Creator LMS!

The LMS Plugin Made for Creators, Coaches, and Trainers

Creator LMS is a complete, creator-friendly LMS platform with built-in eCommerce and, engagement features without being dependent on multiple addons and plugins.

Who’s this for?

  • Solo Creators: Everything you need to launch your first course without buying 10 plugins.

  • Coaches & Educators: Create unlimited courses with different added features, run cohorts, host live events, and build ever growing learning communities right inside WordPress.

  • Agencies: Build LMS sites faster with fewer plugins and fewer headaches.

Whether you want to teach your skills or build a business from your knowledge, Creator LMS gives you the tools to create and sell courses within WordPress.

The core Creator LMS plugin is a totally FREE forever LMS – no limits on your courses, enrollments, standard email automation or earnings.

Documentation | Video Tutorials | 👤 Join our Facebook Community | Public Roadmap

Try Creator LMS Pro 🎉 with amazing features such as built in cohorts, community, memberships, AI suite, gamification, funnels and many more!

👉 Get Creator LMS Pro!! 🎉

Take a look.

Why Choose Creator LMS?

With Creator LMS, you can build courses totally on your own website without being an expert on tech or extensive marketing.

As a creator, you won’t need to stress about spending thousands of dollars on your own platform. Rather, you have all the tools you need to launch a course. No need to stress about too many complicated or commercial setups.

The plugin will give you:

  • Beginner-Friendly LMS Experience – Launch your first course in minutes with an intuitive interface
  • Fully WordPress-Native Setup – Lightweight, fast, and built for creators

You can start earning with courses in only 5 simple steps:

  1. Create courses with videos, audio, or text-based content
  2. Add interactive quizzes and set prerequisites
  3. Choose your course layout and publish
  4. Accept payments via Stripe or Offline payments, or PayPal – no extra plugins needed
  5. Track students and earnings with built-in analytics

If done right, you will start getting enrollments. And while you make money, you can start planning your next course launch.

Here’s a basic overview:

Core Free Features Of Creator LMS

✅ Intuitive Course Builder – Create a structured course curriculum easily with an intuitive, user-friendly builder.

✅ Any Types Of Lessons (Text, Video & Audio) – Add text, video, or audio lessons to deliver engaging, flexible content.

✅ Flexible Quiz Builder – Create quizzes with multiple question types to test student knowledge.

✅ Certificates – Issue custom certificates upon course completion.

✅ Payment Options: Stripe, Mollie & Offline – Accept payments via Stripe, Mollie or manually for full monetization control.

✅ Course Layout Templates – Choose from multiple course layouts to match your brand or teaching style.

✅ Advanced Analytics Dashboard – Track student performance, progress, and revenue with an analytical view.

✅ Automated Emails – Send default emails like course completion, enrollment etc, from within Creator LMS.

✅ Course Prerequisites – Require completion of specific lessons or courses before unlocking new content.

✅ Course Migration Support – Import your existing courses from other LMS plugins in just a few steps.

✅ Native E-commerce – Make the checkout process easier with built-in checkout without any dependencies on other e-commerce tools.

✅ Order management – Manage all your orders with a complete dashboard just like any other eCommerce tools.

✅ Theme Compatibility – Works with 30+ popular WordPress themes and page builders.

✅ Builder Integration – Special widgets for Gutenberg, Elementor, and Bricks Builder.

Creator LMS Pro Features

✅ Cohort-Based Courses – Create real-time courses for engaging with the students directly.

✅ Community For Courses – Build your own community where you can share knowledge, upsell more courses, and engage more students!

✅ Gamification – Boost course completion rates with pop-quizzes, badges, and milestone rewards.

✅ One Click Offer – You will be able to add one-click upsells and downsells right within the LMS platform without depending on any other tools.

✅ AI Suite– Auto-generate lessons, quizzes, and graphics using built-in AI tools. Use our AI model or use any of your preferred ones.

✅ Built-In Automation – Send smart, behavior-based emails based on student progress.Automate enrollment and course purchase emails without depending on any external tools.

✅ Content Protection – Protect your content from copying, recording, or inspecting.

✅ Membership and Subscriptions – Built-in Membership and subscription system to create memberships and manage the subscriptions easily.

✅ Assignments – Prepare assessments for your students so that they can feel challenged during their courses.

✅ More Payment Options – Get more payment options like PayPal, Authorize.net, Razorpay etc.

So, the plugin will help you build courses, monetize them, and influence student engagement for a high completion rate.

👉 Get Creator LMS PRO today

Everything You Need To Create, Launch, and Monetize Courses With High Engagement

Creator LMS will be your go-to solution to create and manage your course business without any complications. This LMS plugin for WordPress is built to help you succeed.

And the plugin comes with every tool needed to help you make course building easy

🚀 Course Creation Made Easy
Creator LMS makes building courses feel effortless, even for non-tech users.

With its intuitive course builder, you can create a complete learning journey without touching a line of code.

Whether you’re adding video lessons, written content, or downloadable materials, everything is designed to help you launch your course quickly and confidently.

  • Course lesson builder with reordering options
  • Lesson types: video, text, downloadable files, quizzes
  • Add quizzes, assignments(pro), and lesson structure visually

🧠 Student Engagement Tools
Engaged students are more likely to complete your course and become loyal fans.
CreatorLMS includes a suite of features to keep learners active and motivated, from dynamic quizzes to progress tracking and smart email nudges.

Reward progress, trigger milestone events, and help your students stay on track.

  • Quizzes upon lesson or chapter completion.
  • Action-based quizzes with multiple question types.
  • Progress tracking and course completion logic.
  • Student dashboards to show learning status.
  • Email automation based on lesson or quiz activity (Pro)
  • Gamification (badges, rewards, leaderboard) (Pro)

💸 Native eCommerce
CreatorLMS includes a native checkout system with Stripe and PayPal support, so you can sell your courses without needing extra tools or integrations. Whether you offer free content or premium training, you have full control over access and pricing.

  • Accept course payments using Stripe, Mollie and Offline Payment Option
  • Accept course payment using PayPal, Authorize.net, Razorpay (Pro)
  • Use a built-in checkout form – no extra tools needed
  • Offer Free or paid courses easily

📝 Separate Quiz Builder
You get a separate quiz builder to add quizzes between lessons for consistent student engagement.

Adding different question types (MCQs, True/False, Fill in the blank) short answers & more) is easier than ever.

You can also design interactive quizzes (PRO) to keep learners motivated.

Whether you’re building a training course, online class, or eLearning program, this feature will help you create quizzes that are both effective and fun!

🤖 AI Suite (PRO)
Get an easy course creation process with powerful built-in AI features. Generate course outlines, lesson plans, quizzes, and even custom visuals with just a few clicks.

CreatorLMS helps you go from idea to fully-built course faster than ever for creators who want to move quickly.

  • Built-in AI Suite
  • Generate course outlines with AI
  • Use your preferred model (OpenAI or Anthropic)

💸 Built In One Click Offers (PRO)
CreatorLMS isn’t just about teaching – it’s about scaling your business. With one click offers inside the course builder, you can instantly add upsell-downsell offers for premium course, cohorts and more!

⚙️ Drive High Engagements With Built In Automation (Pro)
You will be excited to know that we are creating a special internal integration between Creator LMS Pro and Mail Mint.

This will allow you to use email automation to ensure your students remain engaged with every lesson and finish their courses.

With this unique blend, you will be able to:

  • Set email automation workflows based on student progress.
  • Design emails to be sent upon lesson & quiz completion.
  • Offer rewards on course milestones.

Thus, you will have a higher completion rate from students, which will eventually help you gain authority and trust.

Built For Creators

  • Online coaches and mentors
  • Digital skill trainers
  • Corporate and internal educators
  • Content creators
  • Nonprofits or educators going digital

💸 Gamification (PRO)
Engagement is very important for keeping your students with your course until the end and more for the future. You can assign,

📌 Badges
📌 Leaderboards
📌 Learner Levels
📌 Points and Rewards

📈 Growth-Focused

Plus, the platform is optimized for speed, performance, and long-term growth.

  • Detailed Analytics on course sales
  • Advanced analytics on student-course progress & completion
  • Integrates with Mail Mint for automated email marketing & student engagement (Pro)

Privacy Policy

Creator LMS uses Appsero and OpenPanel to collect limited telemetry data after user consent. This helps us troubleshoot issues and improve the product.

No data is collected by default. Data collection starts only after a user allows it via the admin notice.

We do not collect or store any personal or sensitive information, and collected data is not shared with third parties.

This data helps us:
– Find and fix issues faster
– Improve features and performance
– Build a better product for you

We do not collect anything without your consent, and we never sell your data. Your trust matters to us.

Learn how OpenPanel collects and uses data
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Creator LMS to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Follow the setup wizard to configure the plugin for use
sections.faq:
1. Is Creator LMS free to use?

Yes! The core plugin is free and includes everything you need to create and sell courses.

2. Does it support Stripe payments?

Yes. You can accept payments with Stripe and record manual (offline) payments. It also supports PayPal, Mollie and Authorize.net

3. Can I issue certificates?

Yes. Creator LMS allows you to generate completion certificates for each course.

4. Can I migrate courses from another LMS plugin?

Creator LMS is SCORM supported. We also have built in migration from other tools (Tutor LMS & LearnDash) that’s totally free to use.

5. Who can use Creator LMS?

No matter what niche you are in, if you are a subject matter expert, and want to build & monetize courses, you can use Creator LMS.

But ideally, we believe it’s suited for:
– content creators
– Online coaches and mentors
– Digital skill trainers
– Corporate and internal educators
– Nonprofits or educators going digital

However, it is not limited to these niches. Any business can benefit from using sales funnels.

6. How can I report security bugs?

You can report security bugs through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program.

The Patchstack team help validate, triage and handle any security vulnerabilities. Report a security vulnerability.
